commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' The attendance is 41479.
90+6' Bryan Oviedo (Costa Rica) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
90+5' A substitution has been made. Joel Campbell is replaced by Daniel Chacon Salas (Costa Rica).
90+4' Kaoru Mitoma (Japan) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+3' Wataru Endo (Japan) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Kaoru Mitoma (Japan) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Youstin Salas (Costa Rica) on for Celso Borges.

88' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Daichi Kamada (Japan) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Keylor Navas pulls off a brilliant save.
86' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:1.
84' Ko Itakura (Japan) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
82' Here's the change. Yuki Soma leaves the pitch and Takumi Minamino (Japan) comes on as a substitute.

81' 0 - 1 Keysher Fuller Spence (Costa Rica) latches on to a brilliant pass and hits a poor shot towards the middle of the goal, but the ball goes into the back of the net after the goalkeeper makes a howler!
79' Keysher Fuller Spence (Costa Rica) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
79' The corner from Junya Ito (Japan) is hurriedly cleared.

78' Yuki Soma (Japan) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Japan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
77' Hiroki Ito (Japan) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece.
76' A cross by Yuki Soma (Japan) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
74' The foul by Takuma Asano (Japan) was seen by Michael Oliver who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
74' Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
73' Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) is adjudged offside.
72' Yuki Soma (Japan) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
72' Daichi Kamada (Japan) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort.
70' Francisco Calvo (Costa Rica) will miss the next game.
70' Francisco Calvo (Costa Rica) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
69' Keysher Fuller Spence (Costa Rica) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
69' Japan are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
67' Substitution. Ritsu Doan leaves the pitch and is replaced by Junya Ito (Japan).
65' Yuki Soma (Japan) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
65' Luis Fernando Suarez has decided to substitute Anthony Contreras and he is replaced by Jewison Bennette (Costa Rica).
65' Luis Fernando Suarez prepares a substitution. Gerson Torres is replaced by Brandon Aguilera (Costa Rica).
63' Yuki Soma (Japan) unleashes a shot from the free kick, but blazes it over. This is a perfect example of a wasted chance.
62' Substitution. Miki Yamane walks off the pitch and Kaoru Mitoma (Japan) comes on as a substitute.
61' What was Celso Borges (Costa Rica) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
59' Hiroki Ito (Japan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
57' Yuki Soma (Japan) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the right post.
56' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
55' Hiroki Ito (Japan) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Japan keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
51' Yeltsin Tejeda (Costa Rica) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
50' The game is interrupted now, Yeltsin Tejeda (Costa Rica) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
50' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Wataru Endo (Japan) inside the box.
50' Ko Itakura (Japan) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
50' Ritsu Doan (Japan) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
50' Miki Yamane (Japan) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Japan win a corner.
49' Yuki Soma (Japan) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
48' Takuma Asano (Japan) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
48' Wataru Endo (Japan) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

46' Hidemasa Morita (Japan) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went straight towards the roof of the net, but Keylor Navas made an astonishing save!
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Ayase Ueda comes off for Takuma Asano (Japan).
46' Half-time substitution. Yuto Nagatomo will not participate anymore and Hiroki Ito (Japan) is coming on.
46' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Michael Oliver interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Gerson Torres (Costa Rica).
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Miki Yamane (Japan) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
43' Fouls committed – 10:4.
41' Anthony Contreras (Costa Rica) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
39' Yuto Nagatomo (Japan) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Michael Oliver signals.
38' Wataru Endo (Japan) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
37' Ayase Ueda (Japan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Japan are seeing far more of the ball now.
35' Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
34' Bryan Oviedo (Costa Rica) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
31' Yuto Nagatomo (Japan) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
30' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:0.
26' Ritsu Doan (Japan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
25' Yuto Nagatomo (Japan) tries to find Yuki Soma, but he puts too much power on the pass.
23' Anthony Contreras (Costa Rica) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
22' Foul! Wataru Endo (Japan) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
18' Miki Yamane (Japan) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
13' Ritsu Doan (Japan) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
12' Some great controlled play and passing from Costa Rica. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Yuki Soma (Japan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

6' Celso Borges (Costa Rica) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
6' Ritsu Doan (Japan) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
5' Joel Campbell (Costa Rica) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
5' Michael Oliver blows the whistle, Miki Yamane (Japan) is penalised for a foul.
3' Ritsu Doan (Japan) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post.
1' Yuki Soma (Japan) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
